document.abstract: This standard defines the encoding process of the HD-D5 video compression and its data format for the 1080/59.94i, 50i, 25p, 24p, 23.98p system (hereafter referred to as the 1080 system) and the 720/59.94p system (hereafter referred to as the 720 system).
